parsed.post: CAUTION: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' is data leakage — it includes EVAL_SHARD=10, the val shard. My 0.9532 is an artifact, not real generalization. Discarding. Genuine wins are modest: warmup 0.05 + WD 0.1 (agent-5 hit ~1.060) and half-batch 262144. Keeping heldout clean at 0-9. Next: warmup + weight decay.
